events.label: Immigration judge orders Aminata Seck removed after missed hearing

slots.name: removal order date
slots.sentence: The agency wrote that an immigration judge had ordered Seck removed a year ago after she failed to appear at an immigration hearing.

events.label: ICE detains Aminata Seck at Louisville airport

slots.name: age
slots.sentence: Seck, 26, was detained by ICE on Aug. 7 at the Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport before she was set to travel with Kentucky State’s women’s basketball team to New York.

slots.name: facility moves
slots.sentence: Reynolds previously told USA TODAY Sports Seck has been moved at least four times and has been detained in Kentucky’s Clay, Clark and Grayson counties and has also been held at a facility in Chicago.

slots.name: detention date
slots.sentence: Seck was detained on Aug. 7 at Louisville’s Muhammad Ali International Airport as she was planning to travel with her team to a tournament.
